action: Open General and a named space directly
user_goal: I want an Ask link to open the right space
steps: Use Memory → Spaces to create March paperwork
expected: General opens by default and shows starter canvases
The space selector says March paperwork and the new thread is empty
Returning to General restores its view
Home still shows ¥0 safe to spend and a ¥18,780 shortfall on Nov 27 if clients are late

action: Request the Ask view for the current household
user_goal: I want the view to return my selected space privately
preconditions: A household with General and a named space
steps: Check the same-origin view with no space parameter and with the named space id
expected: Both responses return 200 with Cache-Control: private, no-store
The first view selects General and the second selects the named space

action: Request an Ask view without access
user_goal: I want only my household to be able to read my Ask spaces
preconditions: Two households with their own spaces
steps: Check requests without a session, from a foreign origin, and with malformed, unknown or foreign space ids
expected: The missing session returns 401 and the foreign origin returns 403
Each invalid space lookup returns 404 without space data

action: Load an Ask view with kinds kept on this device
user_goal: I want my device-held thread, brief, notes and pins to stay on this device
preconditions: The household keeps its journal, memory and canvases on this device
steps: Load a view for the selected space
expected: The view includes the space metadata and omits turns, briefs, notes and pins for device-held kinds

action: Reach the shared Ask view and canvas request limit
user_goal: I want the app to tell me when I should wait before retrying
preconditions: A household at its canvas request limit
steps: Make a view request with the household’s canvas request bucket exhausted
expected: The view returns 429 for the shared 120 requests per minute household bucket
